entities.summary: The TerraMar Project was a self-described environmental nonprofit organization. It was founded in 2012 in the United States by former socialite and later convicted child sex offender Ghislaine Maxwell. A sister organisation in the United Kingdom was incorporated in 2013. TerraMar (US) announced its closure on 12 July 2019, shortly after New York federal prosecutors arrested Maxwell's associate, the financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. TerraMar (UK) was officially dissolved on 3 December 2019.
